44:40.text: (when Allâh will judge between the creatures)
is the time appointed for all of them -

44:41.text: in aught, and no help can they receive,

44:42.text: Except him on whom Allâh has Mercy. Verily, He is the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

44:44.text: Will be the food of the sinners.

44:45.text: Like boiling oil, it will boil in the bellies,

44:46.text: Like the boiling of scalding water.

44:47.text: "Seize him and drag him into the midst of blazing Fire,

44:48.text: "Then pour over his head the torment of boiling water.

44:50.text: "Verily, this is that whereof you used to doubt!"

44:54.text: . And We shall marry them to Hûr

44:55.text: They will call therein for every kind of fruit in peace and security;

44:56.text: They will never taste death therein except the first death
, and He will save them from the torment of the blazing Fire,

44:57.text: As a Bounty from your Lord! That will be the supreme success!
